brief_summary: Analyze the effect of meal pattern (meal number, frequency, and form) on satiety, gut peptides, insulin, and glucose levels in individuals before and 12-15 months after gastric bypass surgery (GBP).
brief_title: Effect of Meal Number, Frequency, and Form on Satiety and Metabolism After Weight Loss Surgery

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severely obese patients undergoing gastric bypass surgery (GBP)

official_title: Effect of Meal Number, Frequency, and Form on Satiety and Metabolism After Weight Loss Surgery

primary_outcomes.measure: Changes in gut peptides after gastric bypass, during either a liquid or solid meal, or single or multiple isocaloric meals.
primary_outcomes.time_frame: 1 month before GBP Surgery, and 12-15 months post surgery
